fallback.failed: Processing failed. You can try again.

reason.EMBEDDER_UNAVAILABLE: The indexing service was unavailable. It will be retried automatically; you can also try again.
reason.EMBEDDING_FAILED: The indexing model couldn’t process this document. Ask an administrator to check the setup.
